// CHAOS-5156: closes a coverage gap codex round r3 on #2268 surfaced --
// the mixed corpus_jvm_swift directory previously let sibling-language
// fixtures silently satisfy Scala's own "catch"/"?" coverage too, since
// the unfiltered coverage scan didn't separate languages. Scala has real
// try/catch syntax; it has NO ternary operator at all (if/else is used
// as an expression instead), so a bare "?" token can only ever appear as
// a deliberately non-compiling expression -- same shape as
// question_token_coverage.go.txt for Go, which has the identical
// structural gap. Measured directly against real lizard 1.23.0:
// complexity 4 (base 1 + catch + case + ?-as-token).
class Parser {
  def f(): Int = {
    try {
      val x = 0 ? 1
      x
    } catch {
      case e: Exception => 0
    }
  }
}
